title: Generate & commit sample debate runs under runs/ (transcript + verdict + token/cost) for the teacher (Epic 12, issue #86)
prompt:
Run several debates on varied topics and commit each run under runs/ as <run_id>.jsonl plus a readable <run_id>.md (transcript, verdict, token/cost). This is the evidence the teacher reviews.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: Read PRD/READMEs/ARCHITECTURE; TDD markdown exporter; smoke test + 3 real debates; later regenerated all 3 runs on the topic+system-prompt-fixed engine (refs #202/#203, ~$1 API); full gate suite.

note: Generated 3 committed sample runs under runs/ as the teacher's review evidence (PRD §11). No .md exporter existed (grepped packages: only the pricing format_cost_table renderer), so WROTE one, TDD red-first: packages/core/tests/test_run_markdown.py (6 tests, in-memory DebateResult, no network/key), watched the import fail, then implemented to green. NEW packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/export/ subpackage: markdown.py (render_run_markdown(result, run_id) pure renderer + write_run_markdown(result, run_id, runs_dir) file sink) and _sections.py (per-section helpers: transcript grouped by round, closing discussion, controller nudges, verdict, cost). Both files <150 code lines (split, not compressed). The cost section REUSES the existing agent_debate.core.pricing.format_cost_table verbatim — no duplicated pricing/markdown (§4). Re-exported render_run_markdown/write_run_markdown from agent_debate.core.__init__. The jsonl is the LOG package's machine event log; the md is the readable companion rendered from the same completed DebateResult (which carries the priced cost_breakdown). NEW scripts/generate_sample_runs.py: a build-time generator that drives DebateEngine.run (writes runs/<run_id>.jsonl via LOG) then write_run_markdown (writes runs/<run_id>.md). All debate params are CLI args (--rounds/--max-words/--topic/--run-id) — no hard-coded values. Bridges the .env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY into os.environ for pydantic-ai (a blank process ANTHROPIC_API_KEY shadowed the .env value; the script clears the blank shadow, lets Settings read .env, exports the key — key stays in .env, never hard-coded). Forces UTF-8 on stdout/stderr so the pretty console LOG sink never dies on emoji/non-Latin debate text on a legacy Windows code page (cp1255). SMOKE TEST first: one --rounds 1 debate confirmed the engine works end-to-end with the real key (Pro/Con turns, a timeout+retry that recovered, tool calls, closing, verdict, $0.048 priced) before spending on the real runs. Then 3 real runs at --rounds 4 --max-words 120 (reduced rounds for cost; system default is the full 10x150, documented in runs/README.md): policy-congestion-pricing (congestion pricing; Pro won; 73910 tok; $0.313), techethics-ai-art (AI-art copyright; Pro won; 78956 tok; $0.327), lifestyle-morning-routine (5am wakeup; Pro won; 70572 tok; $0.292). ~$0.93 total. Each produced BOTH runs/<run_id>.jsonl AND runs/<run_id>.md; force-added (runs/ is gitignored with an explicit `git add -f` sample-run carve-out). Confirmed NO sk-ant string in any committed run file (LOG redaction holds) and scripts/secret_scan.py reports zero run-file hits (its only finding is the live local .env, the documented pre-existing env failure). Added runs/README.md (light context + reduced-rounds note; the full index is 12.6). Marked 12.5 [x] in docs/TASKS.md; added the 12.5 PROMPTS.md entry (topics + reduced-rounds decision). FLAGGED a separate follow-up: the debaters never receive the actual topic text in their prompt/anchor (build_debater_system_prompt/build_side_anchor say 'the topic' generically), so they ask 'what is the topic?' — out of scope for 12.5 but worth fixing. Gates green: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 230 files formatted; mypy = no issues in 229 source files; pytest --cov = 807 passed, 99.71% total coverage (export module 100%; >=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0; secret_scan.py = only the live .env (pre-existing). Pre-existing failures unchanged (6 failed + 2 errors): branch-protection Unix perms x2, live-tree secret scan/hygiene x2, Windows missing-file path-regex x2, long-topic parametrized teardown errors x2 — NO new failures introduced. Files: NEW core/export/__init__.py, core/export/markdown.py, core/export/_sections.py, core/tests/test_run_markdown.py, scripts/generate_sample_runs.py, runs/README.md, runs/{policy-congestion-pricing,techethics-ai-art,lifestyle-morning-routine}.{jsonl,md}; EDIT core/__init__.py (export re-exports), docs/PROMPTS.md, docs/TASKS.md. REGENERATION (2026-05-31, refs #202/#203): the flagged follow-up became two merged fixes — #202 injects the debate topic into the debater context (prompts.py TOPIC_LINE/topic param) and #203 actually delivers the agent system prompt to the model on the message_history path (context.py system_prompt field + prepended SystemPromptPart). Merged fixed main into task/12.5-sub-sample-runs (clean merge), git rm'd the 3 stale committed runs (.jsonl + .md each), reran a --rounds 1 smoke test on the fixed engine (debaters now name and argue the actual motion, not 'what is the topic?'), and regenerated all 3 runs on the fixed engine at --max-words 120: policy-congestion-pricing (--rounds 4; Pro won; 107744 tok; $0.419), techethics-ai-art (--rounds 3; Con won; 67173 tok; $0.265), lifestyle-morning-routine (--rounds 3; tie; 76344 tok; $0.296). ~$0.98 total (rounds trimmed to 3 on two runs to hold ~$1 budget). Confirmed NO sk-ant in any regenerated run file; secret_scan.py clean on tracked run files. Updated runs/README.md (winners/rounds table + regeneration note) and the docs/PROMPTS.md 12.5 entry (the genuine Prompt-Book lesson: reading one real transcript end-to-end is the cheapest validation of an LLM pipeline and is what surfaced both bugs). docs/TASKS.md 12.5 stays [x]. Closes #86.
